segments.sn18.11:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā rāhulo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn18.11:1.7: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn18.11:1.9: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ –
segments.sn18.11:1.18: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn18.11:1.20: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ –
segments.sn18.11:1.23: “Evaṃ passaṃ, rāhula, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati…pe… sotasmimpi nibbindati… ghānasmimpi nibbindati … jivhāyapi nibbindati… kāyasmimpi nibbindati… manasmimpi nibbindati;
segments.sn18.11:1.24: nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn18.11:1.25: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
